path_step: System displays a generic error message when the authentication service is unavailable during login.
test_scenario: Attempting to log in when the underlying authentication service or database is not accessible.
pre_condition: The authentication service or database responsible for processing login requests is simulated to be unavailable or offline. A valid user account exists.
expected_result: System displays a generic error message like "Login service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later." The user remains on the login modal.
post_condition: User is not logged in; system state is unchanged regarding login.

test_steps.step: Configure the environment to simulate an unavailable authentication service or database.
Enter valid username/email and password for any registered user.
Verify that a generic error message like "Login service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later." is displayed.
Verify that the user remains on the login modal.
